Aisha (CSM): FYI: Bayline flagged as renewal-risk in today's health scan. Active integrations down ~57% over last 9 days and our champion (R. Ortega) moved to a product role. Need quick triage.
Liam (AM): Noted. Do we know if this is surface-area specific? embeddings vs generation vs streaming?
Aisha (CSM): Mostly the ingestion/convert route. Their nightly batched jobs stopped showing activity. Embeddings show a shallower dip (~30%).
Connor (SE): Can you paste the analytics query you pulled? I'll look for auth churn and cache regressions.
Aisha (CSM): SQL I ran:
```sql
SELECT route, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) as calls
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'bayline' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY day DESC;
```
Aisha (CSM): Headline days: 2026-06-11: 1,200; 2026-06-17: 480; 2026-06-19: 360.
alert-bot: Alert: customer_id=bayline quota usage fell below 30-day baseline (auto-tagged: renewal-risk).
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Any open support tickets or billing disputes? Those are common when champions move.
Aisha (CSM): One billing ticket about "unexpected token usage" opened a week ago; it references a spike in compute after a deploy.
Liam (AM): Procurement scribbled "running a short POC with rival" in meeting notes last Tuesday. Could be actively evaluating.
Connor (SE): Running quick telemetry now. If they rotated keys we'd expect 401 storms; if they changed SDK behavior we'd see reduced KV cache hits and many single-token calls. Give me 25m.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Playbook suggestion: offer a 10-day dedicated sandbox (no charge) + an enablement pairing for the new ML owner. If it's a misconfig, pairing + pilot usually recovers usage and renewals.
Aisha (CSM): Agreed. Also propose a short QBR with procurement + infra + dev. Liam, can you schedule?
Liam (AM): On it. Tentative Thu 11-12 PT. I'll send a calendar poll.
Connor (SE): Quick findings: no server-side model fallbacks or latency regression. KV cache hit rate dropped 76% -> 15% between 2026-06-11 and 2026-06-19. Also a cluster of short requests (median tokens/request = 4). Looks like client-side batching was disrupted.
Aisha (CSM): That would explain token burn + billing ticket. I'll DM Bayline and offer sandbox + pairing and ask whether they rolled a new SDK.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a 30-min workshop focusing on batching, context reuse, and embed pooling. Will include a sanitized example of the batching header and quick fixes. ETA 18h.
Liam (AM): I'll mark CRM: tag = "champion-moved", play = "sandbox+pairing", and add a note to keep billing dispute on hold while we investigate.
Aisha (CSM): Connor, can you draft a tiny diagnostics snippet we can send to their engs?
Connor (SE): Draft runbook: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` capture 5 p50/p95 samples; collect 10 recent request_ids for /v1/convert and note whether requests include `X-Batch-Key`. Also check client SDK version.
Aisha (CSM): Nice. I'll send that and offer the sandbox.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Also prepare a simple cost-reconciliation template: tokens/day pre-drop vs post-drop and estimated monthly delta under current patterns. Helps procurement see the impact.
Liam (AM): If procurement pushes competitor pricing, offer a 2-week pilot extension + a scoped technical reference with a similar customer who had the same SDK issue. Request a 1-page POC spec with 3 acceptance criteria.
Aisha (CSM): Actions: 1) Connor full telemetry + sample request_ids (ETA 1h) 2) Zoe workshop (ETA 18h) 3) Liam schedule QBR & update CRM (ETA 12h) 4) Aisha outreach + sandbox invite (ASAP).
Connor (SE): Quick follow-up: found sample requests where `X-Batch-Key` was missing and session tokens were short-lived; I'll paste sanitized examples in the audit.
Aisha (CSM): That explains the sudden quiet and token spike. I'll call their new owner and push the sandbox + pairing. Will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:
